verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a SaaS compliance and audit platform, and open-source availability is a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public source repository, an open license, or source-available code. The documented MCP server and llms.txt are integration and documentation features, not open source, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
